hook.text: Storage facilities miss forty percent of their calls — about fifty-eight thousand dollars a year. Meet Alex. Alex misses none.

save.text: Reserved, tour booked, saved to your system — automatically.

tenant.text: And it's not just new renters. Three out of four callers are existing tenants.

cta.text: Want this answering your phone? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: StoreRight Self-Storage, this is Alex — how can I help?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: I need to store a couch, a bed, and about fifteen boxes from next Monday.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: A ten-by-ten is perfect for that — a hundred and ten a month. Want me to reserve it and book you a tour?

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: Yes please. Monday at two works.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Done — it's reserved, your tour is booked, and I've texted the confirmation. See you Monday, Jenna!

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: Hi, I'm at the gate and my code isn't working.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: No problem, Mark. I've verified the phone on your account — your new gate code is four, eight, one, nine, and the gate is open now.
